title: 可复现研究 · 代码、记录与协作
description: 原创练习，按实际项目使用。20 句练习解释版本、运行环境、工作流记录、数据完整性、文档和隐私保护。

source.title: 科研小盒原创科研英语课程 · 2026-10

sentences.en: A reproducible project records how each output was created.
sentences.zh: 可复现的项目会记录每项输出是如何生成的。
sentences.note: how 引导宾语从句；was created 使用被动语态，将重点放在输出的生成过程上。
sentences.question: What information would let another researcher recreate your main figure?

sentences.en: Version control helps collaborators track changes to the analysis code.
sentences.zh: 版本控制帮助协作者追踪分析代码的变化。
sentences.note: help someone do 表示帮助完成某事；changes to 指针对某对象的修改。
sentences.question: Which changes would you describe in a useful commit message?

sentences.en: Each release should identify the code version used for analysis.
sentences.zh: 每次发布都应注明分析所使用的代码版本。
sentences.note: used for analysis 是过去分词短语，修饰 code version；identify 表示明确指出。
sentences.question: How would a reader find the exact code version behind your results?

sentences.en: An environment file lists the dependencies needed to run the workflow.
sentences.zh: 环境文件列出了运行该流程所需的依赖项。
sentences.note: needed to run 是过去分词短语，修饰 dependencies；environment file 指可保存的软件环境描述。
sentences.question: What dependencies belong in your environment file?

sentences.en: Pinned versions reduce unexpected changes caused by software updates.
sentences.zh: 固定版本可以减少软件更新带来的意外变化。
sentences.note: caused by 是过去分词短语，解释变化的来源；reduce 不表示完全消除兼容性问题。
sentences.question: When would you update a pinned software dependency?

sentences.en: A random seed helps reproduce stochastic steps under compatible conditions.
sentences.zh: 在兼容条件下，随机种子有助于复现随机步骤。
sentences.note: under compatible conditions 保留软件及硬件环境等条件；helps 不把种子等同于完整的复现保证。
sentences.question: Why might the same random seed still produce different outputs?

sentences.en: Raw inputs should remain unchanged throughout the analysis process.
sentences.zh: 在整个分析过程中，原始输入应保持不变。
sentences.note: remain unchanged 表示保持原状；throughout 强调整个过程都应如此。
sentences.question: How do you distinguish original inputs from processed data?

sentences.en: Checksums help detect whether a file has changed during transfer.
sentences.zh: 校验和有助于发现文件是否在传输过程中发生变化。
sentences.note: whether 引出待确认的问题；has changed 使用现在完成时，关注传输后的文件状态。
sentences.question: When would you compare file checksums in your workflow?

sentences.en: Clear file names make intermediate results easier to locate.
sentences.zh: 清晰的文件名让中间结果更容易找到。
sentences.note: make something easier to do 表达改善操作体验；intermediate results 指非最终输出。
sentences.question: What information should an intermediate file name convey?

sentences.en: Relative paths make a project easier to move between computers.
sentences.zh: 相对路径让项目更容易在不同电脑之间迁移。
sentences.note: easier to move 表示更易迁移；between computers 说明迁移的环境范围。
sentences.question: Which absolute paths would you replace before sharing your project?

sentences.en: Configuration files separate adjustable settings from the core analysis logic.
sentences.zh: 配置文件将可调整的设置与核心分析逻辑分开。
sentences.note: separate A from B 表示分离两类内容；adjustable 表示允许按任务调整。
sentences.question: Which settings should a collaborator change without editing the code?

sentences.en: Execution logs help explain where a workflow stopped unexpectedly.
sentences.zh: 运行日志有助于说明流程在什么位置意外停止。
sentences.note: where 引导宾语从句，定位停止位置；unexpectedly 修饰 stopped。
sentences.question: Which log message would help you diagnose a failed run?

sentences.en: Cached outputs must be refreshed when their relevant inputs change.
sentences.zh: 相关输入变化时，必须刷新缓存的输出。
sentences.note: must be refreshed 使用被动语态；relevant inputs 明确只需关注影响该输出的输入。
sentences.question: How would you know that a cached result is outdated?

sentences.en: A small test dataset can reveal broken steps quickly.
sentences.zh: 小型测试数据集能够帮助快速发现失效的步骤。
sentences.note: can reveal 表示发现问题的能力；quickly 修饰 reveal，强调排查速度。
sentences.question: What should a useful test dataset cover?

sentences.en: Documentation should explain both expected inputs and important failure conditions.
sentences.zh: 文档应同时说明预期输入和重要的失败条件。
sentences.note: both A and B 并列两项内容；failure conditions 指可能导致流程无法完成的条件。
sentences.question: Which failure condition would you document for a new user?

sentences.en: A data dictionary defines variables, units, and allowed values clearly.
sentences.zh: 数据字典清楚定义变量、单位及允许的取值。
sentences.note: defines 后接并列宾语；allowed values 指合法类别或数值范围。
sentences.question: Which variable in your dataset most needs a clear definition?

chunks.zh: 变量、单位及允许的取值

sentences.en: Shared examples should avoid exposing private identifiers or access credentials.
sentences.zh: 共享示例应避免泄露私人标识信息或访问凭据。
sentences.note: avoid 后接动名词 exposing；or 连接两类需要保护的信息。
sentences.question: What information would you remove before sharing an example?

sentences.en: Access restrictions should follow the consent terms governing each dataset.
sentences.zh: 访问限制应遵循每个数据集所适用的知情同意条款。
sentences.note: governing each dataset 是现在分词短语，修饰 consent terms；follow 表示遵循。
sentences.question: How would you explain a data access restriction to a collaborator?

sentences.en: A license tells others how they may reuse shared code.
sentences.zh: 许可证说明他人可以如何重用共享代码。
sentences.note: tell someone how 引出操作方式；may 在这里表示许可，而非可能性。
sentences.question: Which reuse permissions should your code license explain?

chunks.en: how they may reuse shared code
chunks.zh: 可以如何重用共享代码

sentences.en: Independent reruns can uncover assumptions missing from the written instructions.
sentences.zh: 由他人独立重新运行，有助于发现书面说明遗漏的前提条件。
sentences.note: missing from 是后置修饰语，修饰 assumptions；can uncover 表示可能发现。
sentences.question: What would you ask a colleague to check during an independent rerun?
